title: Route scheduler
one_line: Assigns a day of service jobs to technicians and orders each route within every rule.
problem: A fire and security servicing firm books a high volume of jobs by dragging each one onto a calendar by hand. They want jobs assigned to the right technicians automatically, in an order that cuts driving time and keeps visits on time.
what_it_does: Builds a full day plan that respects skills, time windows, working hours and lunch
On the sample day: 38 of 40 jobs placed, 0 late, 364.9 min travel, against 31 done, 12 late and 592.5 min for a manual plan
Shows routes on a real map of the Harrogate area and a timeline per technician
Lets the planner drag jobs between technicians and flags any rule a move breaks
Explains in plain words why a job cannot be placed
Imports and exports jobs as CSV and exports the schedule, reporting bad rows by line number
